**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The only MFN-type provision in this agreement benefits us. Section 6 (p0047) binds TrueLink to a one-year price freeze on Hosting Services and caps our rates at the lowest rates it charges any other party — a Vendor-granted MFN in the Client's favour, which the playbook expressly welcomes.

I confirmed there is no reciprocal or Client-side MFN:
- § 5 COMPENSATION (p0044–p0047) contains only fee, invoicing and payment mechanics plus the Vendor-side MFN.
- § 8 COVENANTS AND WARRANTIES OF CLIENT (p0050–p0058) contains compliance, access, credit-data licence and content warranties — no obligation to extend TrueLink our best third-party terms or to match competing offers.
- Targeted searches ("most favored", "no less favorable", "favourable", "best price", "any other party", "will not exceed") returned nothing beyond p0047.

This sits at the preferred position, so consistent with the detection guidance I have not touched the Vendor-granted MFN.
